product_context: PDF-to-Course product: a learner drops in a PDF; the agent generates a continuous multimodal course (chapter/section text explanations + interactive 3D visualizations + 2D HTML interactives + generated images + quizzes), self-paced with an AI companion. Learner level is INFERRED from the source document; for post-secondary/professional material use the 'high' tier defaults.
description: Global teaching-action vocabulary (single source of truth), English tailored edition. Derived from the CN teacher-side vocabulary v2: level differences are fields (stage_availability / stage_notes); families 'aesthetic' and 'create' included; subject_bias and interaction_affinity tags included; self_study_note marks moves that need adaptation in solo learning. Level view files are GENERATED from this file - never hand-edit views.
selection_rule: Actions (leaves with is_selectable=true) may ONLY be selected through a pattern slot's moves_from scope in pattern_library_v1.0_en, filtered by the current learner level (stage_availability) and subject bias. NEVER use this vocabulary as a standalone block-type picker (i.e., no 'pick one type per knowledge block' logic) — that reproduces unordered content dumping. Parent nodes are categories only and are not selectable.

interaction_affinity_enum.interactive_3d: 3D scene: manipulation, spatial structure, simulation, character/camera control. Highest cost. Only for concepts with intrinsic spatial structure or dynamics (see pipeline spatiality test).
interaction_affinity_enum.interactive_2d: 2D HTML/JS interactive or animation: parameter sliders, graphs, drag-and-drop, step players.
interaction_affinity_enum.generated_image: Static generated image/diagram: cheapest visual; default fallback when interaction adds no ICAP upgrade.
interaction_affinity_enum.ai_dialogue: AI companion dialogue / role-play block (the solo-mode counterpart of classroom digital-human and peer interaction).

tag_notes.stage_availability: Learner levels where this action is usable (inferred from source document).
tag_notes.stage_notes: Per-level pedagogy hints; flattened to pedagogy_notes in level views.

tag_notes.interaction_affinity: Hint (non-binding) for the interaction-planning pass: which tool types this action naturally suits.
tag_notes.self_study_note: How to adapt this move when there is no classroom (solo learner + AI companion).
